summary: Full end-to-end test of Immortality Dao Longevity MVP. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests passing across auth, onboarding, practices, path stages (start/complete/checkin flow with min_checkins gate), logs (private/public/nothing_happened/soft-delete/ownership), stats, and community follow/unfollow. Frontend: registered a new user, completed onboarding (path=dao), navigated Path tab, opened Stage 1 detail, tapped Begin, logged a public check-in via stage-checkin -> log/new flow, browsed Library with Dao filter (12 cards), opened a practice detail, wrote and deleted journal entries (including 'Nothing happened today'), viewed Community practitioners + feed, edited profile bio in Settings, and logged out — all end-to-end via testIDs. Found and fixed one critical bug: Journal screen crashed with 'Element type is invalid' because phosphor-react-native v3.0.6 no longer exports the deprecated `Circle` alias (only `CircleIcon`); fixed by importing `CircleIcon as Circle` in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/journal.tsx. After the fix, the Journal tab loads and all reflection flows work.

integration_issues.flow: Direct URL navigation to protected tab after page reload
integration_issues.issue: When a fresh page.goto('/community') is issued (full document reload) shortly after login, the Community screen fires its API call before AuthContext has re-hydrated the session token from AsyncStorage/localStorage, resulting in a 401 that surfaces as an 'Uncaught Error: Not authenticated' red screen in dev mode. In-app tab navigation works correctly. Consider guarding tab screens with a loading state until AuthContext has finished restoring, or wrapping apiFetch calls in useEffect that waits for `authReady`.

react_native_issues.issue: In phosphor-react-native v3.0.6, only the `CircleIcon` name is exported (the deprecated `Circle` alias was dropped for this specific icon while other icons still expose both). Importing `{ Circle }` yields undefined and crashes the Journal screen. Fixed via `import { CircleIcon as Circle, ... }`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/journal.tsx:5. Main agent may want to standardize on the `*Icon` names everywhere for forward compatibility.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking but should be migrated where used (likely via a dependency). Reference: browser console during app load.

action_items: Optional: standardize phosphor-react-native imports on the `*Icon` names (e.g. HouseIcon, CheckIcon) to survive the next major release that will drop remaining deprecated aliases.

Optional: harden AuthContext hydration so direct-URL loads of gated screens (deep links) wait for the token restore before firing API calls; today it works when navigating via in-app tabs but a full reload of /community, /journal, etc. can 401 momentarily.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 789 lines — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, practices, path, logs, community) as the app grows.

generate_illustrations() runs unbounded on startup and swallows all exceptions per practice; that is fine for a lazy backfill but the 24h Cache-Control on illustration_url means missing images (404) will not auto-refresh once generated. Consider bumping a version query param when illustration_path is set.
The /api/community/practitioners endpoint calls build_stats() sequentially inside a loop for up to 50 users — will N+1 slow-down as user count grows. Consider batching logs aggregation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of user-flow tests after Circle fix

seed_data_creation: Test users were created via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix; test logs were created and soft-deleted where possible. Seeker's bio was updated to 'TEST bio update' during Settings test — main agent may want to reset it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth default mode on /auth is REGISTER (has display_name input); toggle-mode switches to Sign In. Session token stored in AsyncStorage on web = localStorage. All tabs render fine via bottom nav; a hard reload directly to a gated route can 401 briefly during AuthContext hydration. Journal 'Circle' icon has been fixed. Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env with /api prefix.
rca_of_issue: Journal crash: phosphor-react-native v3.0.6 module/icons/Circle.js exports only `CircleIcon`, whereas most siblings still expose both `Trash` (deprecated) and `TrashIcon`. Importing `{ Circle }` therefore evaluates to undefined and React throws 'Element type is invalid' when the Journal screen tries to render <Circle/>. Reproduced by registering + navigating to /journal on iteration 0. Mitigated by changing import to `CircleIcon as Circle` in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/journal.tsx and restarting expo. Journal now renders and 'Nothing happened today', write-reflection, and delete flows all work end-to-end.
